description: Deterministic anatomy resolver and SVG renderer over pinned, attributed muscle, organ and brain-region drawings. No network, secrets or storage.

tools.description: Resolve and render up to 12 English anatomical structures into one attributed SVG figure. Input: { structures: string[], view?: 'auto'|'front'|'back'|'both', sex?: 'auto'|'male'|'female', labels?: boolean, legend?: boolean, title?: string }. Each structure receives its own colour and a numbered callout with a leader line. Unsupported, ambiguous or laterality-specific requests fail with an explicit message; anatomy is never invented.

List the anatomical structures this capability can render, with canonical English names, reviewed aliases (marking generalised ones), category, provider, available views, laterality, ontology identifiers and licence. Input: { category?: 'muscle'|'muscle-group'|'organ'|'vessel'|'tissue'|'brain-region'|'body-region', search?: string }.
